chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:

The best of 'gulps' is anger that is swallowed despite being unbearable; for the greatest reward comes with the greatest affliction. Allah never loved people but that He tried them (with afflictions).

key_terms.الْجُرْعَةُ: A gulp or swallow (metaphor for swallowing anger)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for controlling anger according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that suppressing anger is a noble act of endurance, promising great reward for those who bear the trial of their own emotions. This suppression is a sign of divine love, as Allah tests those He favors with the challenge of self-control.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 36. It has been narrated that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:

The best of 'gulps' is anger that is swallowed despite being unbearable; for the greatest reward comes with the greatest affliction. Allah never loved people but that He tried them (with afflictions).
